notes.title: Story 210 Definitive Update. Boost fps and some upgrade on settings
notes.content:
-Boost to fps on foliage



-Improves with some extra options in the menu such as brightness/gamma



-Save game system



I regret the state of the game when it came out. Honestly, I was short on time but I was able to fix the problems mentioned. If you know of more problems, do not hesitate to comment.
